=== no such task
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T9","reason":"not needed"}
refusal:
there is no task 'T9' (the run has tasks T01 to T06)

=== the reason is empty
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T06","reason":"  "}
refusal:
the reason is empty

=== a done task
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T01","reason":"not needed"}
refusal:
T01 is done; its work is already part of the run. Add a task to change it.

=== cancelled: a failed task that another waits for
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T03","reason":"there is nothing to measure"}
answer:
Cancelled T03. T04 depend on it and cannot start until you change or cancel them.

=== already cancelled
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T03","reason":"again"}
refusal:
T03 is already cancelled

=== cancelled: a waiting task that the orchestrator waits for
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T04","reason":"the notes are not needed"}
answer:
Cancelled T04. It is taken out of what you wait for.

=== a task that is being merged
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T02","reason":"wrong approach"}
refusal:
T02 has finished and is being merged; it can no longer be cancelled.

=== a task that is starting
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T05","reason":"wrong approach"}
refusal:
T05 is starting; try again in a moment

=== a task whose agent does not let go
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T05","reason":"wrong approach"}
refusal:
T05 is being stopped but has not let go yet; look again with get_run

=== a task that ended otherwise while it was being stopped
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T05","reason":"wrong approach"}
refusal:
T05 is now merging

=== cancelled: a running task, the last one waited for
orchestrator: cancel_task {"id":"T02","reason":"wrong approach"}
answer:
Cancelled T02. T06 depend on it and cannot start until you change or cancel them. It is taken out of what you wait for.

=== cancelled by a chat: the orchestrator's wait stays
chat: cancel_task {"id":"T07","reason":"the user changed their mind"}
answer:
Cancelled T07.

=== refused for a chat
chat: cancel_task {"id":"T07","reason":"again"}
refusal:
T07 is already cancelled
